## RFQ Comparison Board (Cb)

The signature element: a decision matrix with one column per recorded quote and rows for each quoted line, total, lead time, validity, and compliance. The best value in every numeric row is highlighted; the Award button lives at the foot of its column and disables itself for stale quotes and compliance-lapsed vendors (advisory — AwardRfqCommand re-enforces both gates server-side).

Render-only: the consumer (rfq.gts isolated) supplies resolved quotes and the award callback; the board has no realm access and mutates nothing.

### Example

Mounted in the linked RFQ "Q1 Laptop Refresh" — Acme vs TechSource, with TechSource cheapest on total and Acme fastest on lead time.

### Non-goals

No weighted scoring or ranking formula — the buyer decides; the board only makes the trade-offs legible. No quote entry (that is the RFQ card's concern).
